process_area.title: Technology Asset Security, Cost & Governance Analytics

fields.Participants: Security Mgr (links to VS-27.3), IT Ops (links to VS-27), IT Asset Mgr, Development (links to VS-27.1)
fields.Trigger: New device deployment (W3235); policy update; security findings

workflows.name: IT Asset Security Hardening & Configuration Baseline

Automation Opportunity: - System rule-based auto-approval of "approved software allow-list" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-scan of "Deploy and enforce baselines" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report baseline compliance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-528 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Asset Security, Cost & Governance Analytics (PA-99.3).)
- operational: continuous scanning and auto-remediation; operational: class-specific baselines
Pain Points / Risks: - **Configuration-drift risk**: Devices fall out of baseline over time; mitigated by continuous scanning and auto-remediation
- **POS-constraint risk**: Hardening must coexist with POS offline/legacy requirements (per POS-013); mitigated by class-specific baselines
System Touchpoints: - Configuration/security tools (links to VS-27.3); MDM (W3236); imaging (W3235); risk register (links to VS-21.2)

steps.activity: Security/IT Ops define and maintain hardening baselines per asset class (POS, endpoint, server, network, mobile): CIS/industry benchmarks, BuildRight-specific standards (encryption, AV/EDR, patch level, MDM, least-privilege, disabled services/ports), approved software allow-list; version and publish baselines

Deploy and enforce baselines: build into imaging (W3235), enforce via configuration management and MDM (W3236), monitor drift via scanning (links to VS-27.3), auto-remediate or ticket; gate new assets on baseline compliance before deployment

Audit and report baseline compliance: measure % compliant by class/location, remediate exceptions, report to IT governance (W3253) and security risk register (links to VS-21.2/VS-27.3); align to data-privacy safeguards (links to VS-91) on devices handling personal data

fields.Participants: Security Mgr (links to VS-27.3), IT Ops (links to VS-27), IT Asset Mgr, Finance, Business Owners
fields.Trigger: Vendor end-of-support; CVE/vulnerability advisory; audit finding
fields.Volume: Subset of estate approaching EOL or with unpatched vulnerabilities

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-scan of "scan for known vulnerabilities" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "Track remediation SLA and report" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-528 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Asset Security, Cost & Governance Analytics (PA-99.3).)
- operational: SLA and prioritization; operational: refresh acceleration and isolation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unpatched-vulnerability risk**: Exploit of known CVE causes breach (links to VS-27.3/VS-91); mitigated by SLA and prioritization
- **EOL-support gap**: Vendor no longer patches; mitigated by refresh acceleration and isolation
System Touchpoints: - Vulnerability/security (links to VS-27.3); CMDB/EOL tracking (W3233); change mgmt (links to VS-27.1); risk register (links to VS-21.2)

steps.activity: Security/IT Asset Mgr identify EOL/vulnerable assets: track vendor end-of-support dates per asset (W3233), scan for known vulnerabilities (CVEs per W3247), assess exploitability and exposure; prioritize by risk (critical/high first)

Remediate: patch/upgrade where supported, isolate/compensating-controls where patch unavailable, accelerate refresh (W3238) for EOL assets, decommission where uneconomic; manage business disruption and change control (links to VS-27.1 W132/W495)
steps.r: IT Ops / Security / IT Asset Mgr

steps.activity: Track remediation SLA and report: open vulnerabilities/EOL inventory, mean-time-to-remediate, exceptions with risk acceptance and expiry; feed risk register (links to VS-21.2) and audit support (W3256)

fields.Participants: IT Asset Mgr, Finance (links to VS-17.4), IT Ops (links to VS-27), Procurement

workflows.name: IT Asset Total Cost of Ownership Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-analyze of "Analyze TCO drivers and comparisons" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "Feed TCO into decisions" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-528 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Asset Security, Cost & Governance Analytics (PA-99.3).)
- operational: comprehensive TCO model; operational: granular modeling
Pain Points / Risks: - **Hidden-cost risk**: Undercounting support/operations understates true TCO; mitigated by comprehensive TCO model
- **Model-oversimplification risk**: Aggregate TCO hides class-level variation; mitigated by granular modeling
System Touchpoints: - TCO analytics/BI (links to VS-28); finance (links to VS-17.4); CMDB (W3233); procurement (links to VS-34)

steps.activity: IT Asset Mgr/Finance build TCO model per asset class/model: acquisition (capex), software/licenses (W3241), deployment/config (W3235), support/maintenance/break-fix (W3237), operations (power, network, management), refresh/disposal (W3238/W3239); annualize over lifecycle

Analyze TCO drivers and comparisons: cost per device, per store, per user; compare models/vendors/strategies (own vs lease per VS-96 parallel, standard vs premium); identify cost outliers and optimization opportunities (W3242/W3244)
Feed TCO into decisions: catalog selection (W3234), refresh policy (W3238), make/buy/lease, vendor selection (W3255); report TCO trends and optimization savings to IT governance and finance

fields.Participants: IT Asset Mgr, Finance (links to VS-72/VS-17), IT Ops (links to VS-27), Entity/Dept Owners

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-identify of "identify under-utilized assets and over-provisioning" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-assign of "reassign to higher-value use" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-count of "accountability, report unit economics to entity finance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-528 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Asset Security, Cost & Governance Analytics (PA-99.3).)
- operational: utilization analytics; operational: transparent usage data and methodology
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-provisioning waste**: Idle capacity inflates cost; mitigated by utilization analytics
- **Chargeback-dispute risk**: Entities contest allocations; mitigated by transparent usage data and methodology
System Touchpoints: - Utilization/monitoring (links to VS-27); shared services/chargeback (links to VS-72); finance (links to VS-17); BI (links to VS-28)

steps.activity: IT Asset Mgr measure utilization: device uptime/usage, software-feature usage (W3242), cloud resource utilization (W3244), capacity vs demand; identify under-utilized assets and over-provisioning
Right-size: consolidate under-utilized assets, down-size configurations, retire redundant capacity, reassign to higher-value use; balance utilization with resilience/redundancy requirements

Chargeback/showback to consuming entities (5 entities per VS-72) and departments: allocate IT asset cost by usage (links to VS-72 shared-services chargeback), drive accountability, report unit economics to entity finance

fields.Participants: IT Asset Mgr, IT Governance, Security (links to VS-27.3), Finance, Audit (links to VS-21), Data Governance (links to VS-28)
fields.Trigger: Annual governance cycle; policy refresh; audit finding

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "enterprise data governance council" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "Measure and report ITAM maturity" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-528 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Asset Security, Cost & Governance Analytics (PA-99.3).)
- operational: annual refresh; operational: maturity model and improvement plan
Pain Points / Risks: - **Policy-staleness risk**: Outdated policy fails to address new tech (cloud, SaaS, AI); mitigated by annual refresh
- **Low-maturity risk**: Weak ITAM leads to cost/compliance/security issues; mitigated by maturity model and improvement plan
System Touchpoints: - Policy/CMS (links to VS-22/VS-88); data governance (links to VS-28/VS-29); audit (links to VS-21)

steps.activity: IT Asset Mgr/IT Governance maintain ITAM policy framework: hardware lifecycle, software licensing, SaaS/cloud, security baseline (W3249), disposal (W3239/W3254), acceptable use (links to VS-27.3), roles/responsibilities, authority matrix; align with VS-28 data governance and VS-29 master-data governance

Operate ITAM stewardship: assign asset owners/stewards per class, define data-quality standards for the CMDB (W3233) and SAM (W3241), conduct training and awareness, manage exceptions/variances; integrate with enterprise data governance council (links to VS-28 W1177)

Measure and report ITAM maturity: KPIs (CMDB accuracy, license compliance %, refresh-cycle adherence, disposal-compliance %), maturity model (people/process/technology), continuous improvement; report to IT steering and audit (links to VS-21)

fields.Participants: IT Asset Mgr, Privacy/DPO (links to VS-91), Sustainability (links to VS-73/VS-25), Finance (links to VS-35), Legal, Audit (links to VS-21)

workflows.name: Asset Disposal Compliance (Data Privacy / BIR / E-Waste)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "document chain-of-custody and disposal method, comply with hazardous-waste…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "records per BIR 10-year requirement" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-528 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Asset Security, Cost & Governance Analytics (PA-99.3).)
- operational: certified sanitization and certificates; operational: accredited vendor and documentation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Privacy-breach risk**: Improper sanitization exposes personal data (links to VS-91 NPC); mitigated by certified sanitization and certificates
- **Environmental-fine risk**: Improper e-waste disposal violates DENR rules (links to VS-73.2); mitigated by accredited vendor and documentation
System Touchpoints: - Privacy (links to VS-91); environment (links to VS-73/VS-25); fixed assets (links to VS-35); tax (links to VS-79); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Ensure data-privacy compliance on disposal: certified sanitization (NIST 800-88) for all data-bearing media (W3239), retain sanitization certificates, manage data-subject obligations (links to VS-91 — secure destruction of personal data per RA 10173); DPO oversight

Ensure e-waste/environmental compliance: use DENR-accredited TSD vendors (links to VS-73.2 hazardous/e-waste), document chain-of-custody and disposal method, comply with hazardous-waste registration; manage CSR/donation with sanitization and end-use controls

Ensure financial/BIR compliance: derecognize assets (links to VS-35.3), document disposal for tax (gain/loss, links to VS-79), retain records per BIR 10-year requirement (links to VS-88); support external audit (links to VS-22.2) and privacy/environmental audits

fields.Participants: IT Asset Mgr, Procurement (links to VS-34/VS-67), IT Ops (links to VS-27), Finance, Legal
fields.Trigger: Warranty expiry; vendor performance issue; contract renewal

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "track vendor performance" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "Vendor scorecard and review" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-528 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Asset Security, Cost & Governance Analytics (PA-99.3).)
- operational: warranty tracking; operational: multi-vendor strategy where feasible
Pain Points / Risks: - **Warranty-leakage risk**: Paying for in-warranty repairs or extended warranties on low-failure assets; mitigated by warranty tracking
- **Vendor-lock risk**: Over-dependence on one vendor; mitigated by multi-vendor strategy where feasible
System Touchpoints: - Vendor master (links to VS-29/VS-03); procurement (links to VS-34); CMDB/warranty (W3233); scorecard (links to VS-67)

steps.activity: IT Asset Mgr/Procurement manage IT vendor relationships: maintain vendor master (links to VS-29), framework agreements (W3234), warranty/SLA terms, RMA process (W3237), support tiers, escalation contacts; track vendor performance (delivery, quality, support responsiveness)

Manage warranties per asset: track warranty start/end and coverage per serial (W3233), decide on extended-warranty purchase (cost vs expected break/fix), ensure RMA eligibility before out-of-warranty (W3237); manage vendor support contracts (vendor-specific support plans)

Vendor scorecard and review (links to VS-67 methodology): periodic business review, performance scorecard, issue resolution, renewal/renegotiation (W3245), rationalize to preferred vendors; feed catalog decisions (W3234)

fields.Participants: IT Asset Mgr, Security (links to VS-27.3), Risk (links to VS-21.2), Audit (links to VS-21), Privacy (links to VS-91)

workflows.name: Technology Asset Risk Register & Audit Support

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "enterprise risk register" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "Support internal/external audit" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-post of "posture to IT steering and audit committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-528 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Asset Security, Cost & Governance Analytics (PA-99.3).)
- operational: integration (links to VS-21); operational: proactive controls and timely remediation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unmanaged risk**: ITAM risks not captured in enterprise risk register; mitigated by integration (links to VS-21.2)
- **Audit-finding risk**: Audit identifies control gaps; mitigated by proactive controls and timely remediation
System Touchpoints: - Risk register (links to VS-21.2); audit (links to VS-21); security (links to VS-27.3); privacy (links to VS-91); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: IT Asset Mgr/Security maintain ITAM risk register: asset-related risks (EOL/vulnerable W3250, non-compliant licenses W3246, ghost assets W3233, disposal-privacy W3254, lost/stolen W3240), assess likelihood/impact, assign owner and mitigation, track to closure; integrate to enterprise risk register (links to VS-21.2)

Support internal/external audit (links to VS-21/VS-22.2): provide CMDB (W3233), SAM (W3241), disposal certificates (W3239/W3254), license/contract records (W3245), privacy controls (links to VS-91); respond to findings and remediate

Continuous improvement: incorporate audit findings, incidents (W3240/W3246), and industry developments into policy (W3253) and controls; report ITAM risk posture to IT steering and audit committee (links to VS-21/VS-36)
